description: A connection acts on one workspace at a time. This moves it onto another workspace the user belongs to (id or slug from list_workspaces) for every later call, until switched again, and returns the new context. Use this when the user names a workspace other than the current one; confirm with them before switching. Returns switched and the full get_context shape for the new workspace, which says what that workspace's plan allows. Does NOT create workspaces and does NOT touch posts or accounts.

workspace.description: Workspace id or slug from list_workspaces.

name: switch_workspace
title: Switch workspace
